# gitmoap_repository_branch_rules (Data Source)

List branch rules for a repository. The rules the repository declares itself, or with `inherited=true` the rules in effect for it: its own and its groups', a nearer rule replacing a farther one for the same pattern and an enforced group rule tightening whichever wins, each naming where it comes from. Anyone who can see the repository may call it.

The token needs `branch_rule:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_branch_rules" "api" {
  repo_id = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Optional

- `inherited` (Boolean) When true, return the rules in effect for the repository — its own plus those inherited from ancestor groups — rather than only the rules it declares itself

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `allow_force_push` (Boolean)
- `allowed_to_merge` (String)
- `allowed_to_push` (String)
- `branch_pattern` (String)
- `branch_rule_id` (String)
- `merge_allowlist` (List of String)
- `push_allowlist` (List of String)
- `repository_id` (String)
- `require_code_owner_approval` (Boolean)
